title: PUT /v1/mailboxes/{id} request
description: Store a version of an own mailbox record (expected_version 0 creates it; a user's first mailbox becomes primary), sealed under the caller's CK, author the caller or the caller's own-identity agent (03-api.md section 4.8, ADR-099 section 2). use: the plaintext mirror of the sealed release; absent, the mirror stays.
